blocks.title: The edge is people, not pliers
blocks.body: Copycats can buy the same rings. They cannot easily copy a gallery full of member work, monthly challenges, and local clubs that already know each other's weave.

blocks.heading: Badges are for craft, not hierarchy
blocks.body: A skill badge means you passed QC samples and can take paid assembly. It is not a rank people buy. How-to lessons stay free enough that a curious builder can reach the badge without a paywall maze.

blocks.heading: A simple monthly rhythm
items: Publish one design challenge with a clear size and color constraint.
Feature gallery winners (permission first) in content clips.
Run one how-to that unlocks the next badge checkpoint.
Optional: host or list a local meetup.

blocks.quote: The catalog is rings. The moat is the room where people learn to link them.
